text:
規定打席(3.1打席×チーム試合数)の判定には、打数ではなく打席数(PA)が必要です。Batting には PA 列がないため、PA = AB + BB + HBP + SH + SF(+ 打撃妨害は含まれない)で近似し、チームの試合数は Teams テーブルの G を使います。シーズン中に複数球団でプレーした選手(stint が複数)は、年間合算で判定します。

```sql
WITH player_season AS (
    SELECT
        playerID,
        SUM(AB) AS AB,
        SUM(H) AS H,
        SUM(AB + COALESCE(BB, 0) + COALESCE(HBP, 0) + COALESCE(SH, 0) + COALESCE(SF, 0)) AS PA
    FROM Batting
    WHERE yearID = 2021
    GROUP BY playerID
),
team_games AS (
    SELECT MAX(G) AS G
    FROM Teams
    WHERE yearID = 2021
)
SELECT
    ps.playerID,
    CAST(ps.H AS DOUBLE) / ps.AB AS batting_average
FROM player_season ps
CROSS JOIN team_games tg
WHERE ps.PA >= 3.1 * tg.G
  AND ps.AB > 0
ORDER BY batting_average DESC
LIMIT 5;
```
